lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast vertical lines traversing the lateral torso, with roughly equidistant spacing of 30-50 pixels between anterior segments, narrowing in the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the fourth anterior line where the segment splits into two distinct paths at the mid-torso level; merging of lower segments visible on the ninth line near the ventral margin.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1, 2, 4, and 5 (counting from anterior) show terminal discontinuities where the line breaks into isolated circular blobs before reaching the lower torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of approximately 7-9 distinct white spots is visible on the upper hind limb and posterior flank, showing a higher density than the anterior spots.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of three distinct spots forming a geometric line across the mid-haunch, parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Two prominent white circular spots on the lower cheek; a distinct white patch on the lower throat area; a dark pigmented line running along the dorsal ridge.
